title: Any%

start.note: The normal fresh-game arrival after the opening sequence; the exact position and the first controllable frame are still to measure.

party.source: WRAM at the end of the Podunk opening, room 0x46, of a fresh game (records $0A26 / $0A70; the Boy holds the Bone Crusher). Arriving in Prehistoria turns the Dog into its Act 1 form; its stats are assumed to stay.

assumptions: The Boy is the active character unless a step says otherwise.
Bytes no step has written are 0 (a fresh game); enemy drops are the draft's numbers, not simulated.

steps.action: Start at the normal fresh-game arrival.
steps.check: Use the game's own start position, not a hand-picked tile.
Which gourd: B-trigger #1 is a guess; the room's Petal gourds give a Petal, its money gourd (B #0) 15 Talons.
The first Wimpy Flower the enter script places, nearest the gourd: a guess. What "both" means for control, damage and reward.

steps.action: Let the flower kill the Boy.
steps.check: Which flower: spawn 9 is the nearest one left (spawn 7 died in step 3), a guess. Hits to death and elapsed time; what the Dog does meanwhile.

steps.action: Take the north exit to the raptor screen: park the Dog on the trigger, press Select when the Boy dies.

steps.check: A fixed time, an enemy, or a transition condition?
How the route gets from the raptors into the hut; which gourd gives the Talons.

steps.action: Take the exit to Fire Eyes' village.
steps.check: Which of the hut doors (step-on #6 is the one under the Nectar gourd's hut: a guess), and the landing point.
Which hut; the route is not drafted past here.

variants.title: Any% 16 HBs (for Thraxx)
variants.note: Requested variant; "HB" and the Thraxx requirement are not expanded yet, so it shares every drafted step.
